device_label: 1 mm CC-SOH MZM, BaTiO3 high-k slotline
epitaxy_or_stack: Si slot waveguide on 220 nm SOI: rails 200 nm wide, slot 100 nm, strip waveguide 500 nm wide; amorphous BaTiO3 slabs 150 nm thick, 1 um wide between slot waveguide and gold electrodes (n 1.85 at 1550 nm); 2 um buried oxide
modulation_format: OOK (64 and 100 GBd); PAM4 (64 and 100 GBd)
driver: 120 GSa/s AWG (45 GHz analog bandwidth) with RF amplifier (Centellax UA1L65VM); 50 ohm termination; digital pre-compensation
notes: Single device characterized; the paper does not explicitly restate that the Sec. 4 data chip is the Fig. 2 chip (tag device_identity_unresolved), so system results sit on this row. Bandwidth: 3 dB on detected RF power (phase-modulation index down by 1/sqrt2), referenced to zero frequency, 50 ohm terminated, photodiode/probes de-embedded; 6 dB means photocurrent power down by 4; 3 dB value read on a noisy plateau. Wavelength 1550 nm is nominal (Eq. S13; data run near 1550 nm); wavelength of the Vpi and EO-response measurements is not stated. Drive about 1 Vpp: reference plane (amplifier output vs device) not stated; do not rank across rows without a plane tag. BER: 64 GBd OOK below 1e-6 (no errors in about 1e6 symbols); 100 GBd OOK 4e-6; 64 GBd PAM4 5e-5; 100 GBd PAM4 9e-3 (electrical back-to-back 1.7e-3). Operating point set by wavelength via 80 um arm imbalance, DC bias fine-tuning; EO response corrected for photodiode, probes, cables. Vpi measured at low frequency; no RF Vpi. Fiber-to-fiber loss includes grating couplers (about 5 dB each) and about 3 dB other passive loss; no on-chip-only number stated. In-device r33 about 34 pm/V (authors, from Vpi*L). Measured BTO film: eps_r about 18, tan delta about 0.05 at 60 GHz; BTO dielectric loss 0.58 dB/mm at 50 GHz. Authors' predictions not entered: velocity-mismatch 3 dB bandwidth about 220 GHz (derived), 1 um gold line bandwidth far beyond 100 GHz (simulated). Not reported: extinction ratio, on-chip optical power, Z0 value, electrode gap, energy per bit, RF Vpi, temperature.

il_onchip_includes: phase shifter (5.4 dB) plus other structures (3 dB couplers, routing waveguides, etc.)
il_onchip_excludes: fiber/grating coupling loss, stated by the authors as an unoptimized coupling loss of about 10 dB (per coupler or per pair not stated)
substrate: silicon-on-insulator (220 nm Si device layer, 200 mm wafer)
epitaxy_or_stack: Fishbone Bragg-grating CROW on 220 nm SOI: period 300 nm, sidewall corrugation depth 190 nm, Np 20 periods, Nr 10 resonators, lambda/4 phase-shifter regions; lateral pn junction, P and N doping 5.0e17 cm^-3 at the core, P+/P++/N+/N++ contact doping (levels not stated); 90 nm partially etched slab; GSGSG Cu electrode
modulation_format: OOK, 70 / 84 / 98 / 100 / 112 Gb/s; eye diagrams at 100 and 112 Gb/s without pre-equalization or DSP; BER data with offline FFE and MLSE at the receiver; BER below the 7 percent HD-FEC line (3.8e-3) up to 98 Gb/s; at 112 Gb/s best BER about 1.7e-2 (Fig. 4(h), figure read), marginally above the 20 percent FEC line (about 1.5e-2), unlike the text claim of below 2e-3
driver: SHF 12104A bit pattern generator with SHF C603B MUX (eye diagrams); Keysight M8199A AWG (BER); no electrical amplifier stated
notes: Single device characterized (124 um modulation region per arm, Fig. 3a). All values from the arXiv v1 preprint, not the Science Advances VoR; Supplement not cached. Not reported in the preprint: Vpi, Vpi*L, measured modulation efficiency (so vpi_convention empty), drive amplitude, bias voltage, optical input power, Z0 value, n_RF, RF loss, energy per bit, capacitance, temperature; no per-length propagation loss entered. Design-stage values not entered as device metrics (simulated, Sec. 2 and Fig. 2): efficiency factor 0.013 pi/V at the design point (voltage not stated), optical bandwidth about 140 GHz, electrical bandwidth about 200 GHz at 4 V, Q_propagating about 5000; Fig. 2(g) shows simulated electrode loss for 124 um. Bandwidth: 110 GHz is the crossing of the authors' fit to the S21 curve (Fig. 4c; basis derived, not a direct trace crossing); measured trace spans 0 to 110 GHz and reaches about -3 to -4 dB at the end, so the crossing sits at the instrument limit (bw_measured_to_ghz = 110). Curve starts at 0 dB at low frequency, hence reference dc (derived); it shows about +1.5 dB peaking near 20 GHz (read from figure). Authors say the result is slightly degraded by RF probe loss; de-embedding, bias, operating wavelength and the dB convention of S21 (electrical or optical) are not stated. Wavelength 1550 nm is nominal: the mid-gap passband is about 8 nm wide around 1550 nm (design 11 nm), data wavelengths span 1548-1556 nm (Fig. 4f-g); wavelength of the S21 measurement not stated. ER is the dynamic ER at 112 Gb/s (2.15 dB); 3.15 dB at 100 Gb/s (Fig. 4d caption); ER, OMA and SNR vary by less than 0.5 dB across the passband (Fig. 4f). Data rate: OOK so baud equals bit rate (derived); text says BER is below HD-FEC (3.8e-3) up to 98 Gb/s and below SD-FEC (2e-3) up to 112 Gb/s, but in Fig. 4h the 20 percent FEC line reads about 1.5e-2 and the best 112 Gb/s point about 1.7e-2 (figure reading), so the SD-FEC claim is not confirmed from the figure; max_line_rate_gbps 112 is the demonstrated line rate (eyes and BER measured), not an FEC-compliant rate (BER is below the 7 percent HD-FEC line only up to 98 Gb/s), and no net rate is entered. Insertion loss: 6.8 dB on-chip with 5.4 dB from the phase shifter (Methods p.15); wording of the excluded coupling loss is ambiguous.
